verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page advertises "CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically" and a Deal View that summarizes insights. Its webhook API exposes an `include_crm_matches` option, which suggests meetings are matched to CRM records. Together these cover the core of auto-syncing meeting summaries onto the right records, but the evidence is short marketing lines rather than detailed documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence naming HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio as supported CRMs, no documentation of how meetings are matched to contact versus deal records, no detail on which notes or summaries are written to the CRM, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
